<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Kotemah — Calculadora de Resistencia de Materiales</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@300;400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #0d0f14;
    --surface: #161920;
    --surface2: #1e2230;
    --border: #2a2f3e;
    --accent: #f4a11d;
    --accent2: #e05c1a;
    --text: #e8eaf0;
    --text-dim: #8891a8;
    --green: #3ecf8e;
    --red: #ff4d6d;
    --blue: #4fa3e0;
  }

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  body {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    min-height: 100vh;
  }

  /* HEADER */
  header {
    background: var(--surface);
    border-bottom: 3px solid var(--accent);
    padding: 20px 40px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 20px;
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 100;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  }

  .logo-icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    background: var(--accent);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    clip-path: polygon(10% 0%, 90% 0%, 100% 10%, 100% 90%, 90% 100%, 10% 100%, 0% 90%, 0% 10%);
  }

  .logo-icon svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; color: #000; }

  header h1 {
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    color: var(--text);
  }

  header h1 span { color: var(--accent); }

  .subtitle {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  /* MENU */
  .menu-container {
    padding: 30px 40px 0;
    max-width: 1300px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .menu-label {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--accent);
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  .menu-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
  }

  .menu-btn {
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--text-dim);
    padding: 14px 16px;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-align: left;
    transition: all 0.2s;
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .menu-btn::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
    width: 3px;
    background: var(--accent);
    transform: scaleY(0);
    transition: transform 0.2s;
  }

  .menu-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--text); background: var(--surface2); }
  .menu-btn:hover::before { transform: scaleY(1); }
  .menu-btn.active { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); background: var(--surface2); }
  .menu-btn.active::before { transform: scaleY(1); }

  .menu-btn .btn-icon { font-size: 1.3rem; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .menu-btn .btn-title { display: block; font-weight: 600; }
  .menu-btn .btn-sub { display: block; font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 2px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; }

  /* MAIN CONTENT */
  .main {
    max-width: 1300px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 40px 60px;
  }

  .calc-section { display: none; }
  .calc-section.visible { display: block; animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease; }

  @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

  .section-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    padding-bottom: 20px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .section-number {
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
    font-size: 4rem;
    color: var(--border);
    line-height: 1;
    min-width: 60px;
  }

  .section-info h2 {
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
    font-size: 2rem;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    color: var(--text);
  }

  .section-info p {
    color: var(--text-dim);
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    margin-top: 4px;
    max-width: 600px;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  /* CALC LAYOUT */
  .calc-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 20px;
    align-items: start;
  }

  @media (max-width: 900px) { .calc-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

  .card {
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 24px;
  }

  .card-title {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--accent);
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
  }

  .card-title::after {
    content: '';
    flex: 1;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--border);
  }

  /* INPUTS */
  .input-group {
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .input-group label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
  }

  .input-group label span.var {
    color: var(--accent);
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .input-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    align-items: stretch;
  }

  .input-row input, .input-row select {
    flex: 1;
    background: var(--bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--text);
    padding: 10px 14px;
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    outline: none;
    transition: border-color 0.2s;
  }

  .input-row input:focus, .input-row select:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
  .input-row select option { background: var(--surface); }

  .unit-tag {
    background: var(--surface2);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-left: none;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--text-dim);
    white-space: nowrap;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
  }

  /* BUTTONS */
  .calc-btn {
    width: 100%;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: #000;
    border: none;
    padding: 14px;
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 8px;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }

  .calc-btn:hover { background: var(--accent2); color: #fff; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(244,161,29,0.3); }
  .calc-btn:active { transform: translateY(0); }

  /* RESULTS */
  .result-card {
    background: var(--bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--accent);
    padding: 20px;
    margin-top: 16px;
  }

  .result-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }

  .result-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }

  .result-label {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--text-dim);
  }

  .result-value {
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: var(--green);
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .result-value.warn { color: var(--accent); }
  .result-value.danger { color: var(--red); }

  /* SVG DIAGRAMS */
  .diagram-container {
    background: var(--bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 16px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  .diagram-container svg { max-width: 100%; height: auto; }

  /* FORMULA DISPLAY */
  .formula-box {
    background: var(--surface2);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--blue);
    padding: 14px 16px;
    margin: 16px 0;
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--blue);
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  /* TABS for subsections */
  .tabs {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .tab-btn {
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--text-dim);
    padding: 9px 18px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }

  .tab-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--text); }
  .tab-btn.active { background: var(--accent); color: #000; border-color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }

  .tab-content { display: none; }
  .tab-content.active { display: block; }

  /* Sub-inputs grid */
  .inputs-2col { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
  @media (max-width: 600px) { .inputs-2col { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

  /* Section cross */
  .section-picker {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .shape-btn {
    background: var(--bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--text-dim);
    padding: 8px 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 0.78rem;
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    transition: all 0.15s;
  }

  .shape-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--text); }
  .shape-btn.active { border-color: var(--accent); background: rgba(244,161,29,0.1); color: var(--accent); }

  .status-ok { color: var(--green); font-size: 0.75rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; }
  .status-fail { color: var(--red); font-size: 0.75rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; }

  .divider {
    border: none;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    margin: 20px 0;
  }

  .info-badge {
    display: inline-block;
    background: rgba(79,163,224,0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(79,163,224,0.3);
    color: var(--blue);
    padding: 4px 10px;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  /* home screen */
  .home-screen {
    padding: 40px 0 20px;
  }

  .home-hero {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 30px;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
    align-items: center;
  }

  @media (max-width: 800px) { .home-hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

  .home-hero h2 {
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
    font-size: 3.5rem;
    letter-spacing: 4px;
    line-height: 1.05;
    color: var(--text);
  }

  .home-hero h2 em { color: var(--accent); font-style: normal; }

  .home-hero p {
    color: var(--text-dim);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    line-height: 1.7;
    margin-top: 14px;
  }

  .home-features {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 1px;
    background: var(--border);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    margin-top: 20px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 700px) { .home-features { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }

  .feature-item {
    background: var(--surface);
    padding: 20px;
  }

  .feature-item .fi-num {
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
    font-size: 2rem;
    color: var(--border);
  }

  .feature-item .fi-title {
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--text);
    margin: 4px 0;
  }

  .feature-item .fi-desc {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--text-dim);
  }

  .start-btn {
    display: inline-block;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: #000;
    border: none;
    padding: 16px 40px;
    font-family: 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    letter-spacing: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 24px;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }

  .start-btn:hover { background: var(--accent2); color: #fff; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(244,161,29,0.3); }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Kotemah Logo" style="height:44px;object-fit:contain;background:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;">
  <div>
    <div class="subtitle" style="margin-top:4px">Calculadora de Resistencia de Materiales</div>
  </div>
</header>

<!-- NAVIGATION MENU -->
<div class="menu-container">
  <div class="menu-label">▸ Selecciona el tipo de cálculo</div>
  <div class="menu-grid">
    <button class="menu-btn active" onclick="showSection('home')">
      <span class="btn-icon">🏠</span>
      <span class="btn-title">Inicio</span>
      <span class="btn-sub">Panel principal</span>
    </button>
    <button class="menu-btn" onclick="showSection('deflexion')">
      <span class="btn-icon">〰️</span>
      <span class="btn-title">Deflexión en Vigas</span>
      <span class="btn-sub">Voladizo / Biapoyada</span>
    </button>
    <button class="menu-btn" onclick="showSection('cortante')">
      <span class="btn-icon">✂️</span>
      <span class="btn-title">Esfuerzo Cortante</span>
      <span class="btn-sub">Fuerza de corte</span>
    </button>
    <button class="menu-btn" onclick="showSection('torsion')">
      <span class="btn-icon">🔩</span>
      <span class="btn-title">Torsión</span>
      <span class="btn-sub">Deformación angular</span>
    </button>
    <button class="menu-btn" onclick="showSection('flexion')">
      <span class="btn-icon">📐</span>
      <span class="btn-title">Flexión / Momento</span>
      <span class="btn-sub">Esfuerzo de flexión</span>
    </button>
    <button class="menu-btn" onclick="showSection('columnas')">
      <span class="btn-icon">🏛️</span>
      <span class="btn-title">Columnas (Euler)</span>
      <span class="btn-sub">3 casos de apoyo</span>
    </button>
    <button class="menu-btn" onclick="showSection('inercia')">
      <span class="btn-icon">📏</span>
      <span class="btn-title">Momento de Inercia</span>
      <span class="btn-sub">Secciones transversales</span>
    </button>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="main">

  <!-- ============ HOME ============ -->
  <div id="sec-home" class="calc-section visible">
    <div class="home-screen">
      <div class="home-hero">
        <div>
          <h2>CALCULADORA DE<br><em>RESISTENCIA</em><br>DE MATERIALES</h2>
          <p>Herramienta técnica para cálculos de deflexión en vigas, esfuerzos cortantes, deformación por torsión, flexión, análisis de columnas y momentos de inercia de secciones transversales.</p>
          <button class="start-btn" onclick="showSection('deflexion')">COMENZAR →</button>
        </div>
        <div>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%">
            <!-- Grid background -->
            <defs>
              <pattern id="grid" width="20" height="20" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
                <path d="M 20 0 L 0 0 0 20" fill="none" stroke="#1e2230" stroke-width="1"/>
              </pattern>
            </defs>
            <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#161920"/>
            <rect width="400" height="300" fill="url(#grid)"/>
            <!-- Viga biapoyada con deflexión -->
            <line x1="40" y1="130" x2="360" y2="130" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="2"/>
            <!-- Deflexión -->
            <path d="M 40 130 Q 200 195 360 130" fill="none" stroke="#f4a11d" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="6 3"/>
            <!-- Apoyos -->
            <polygon points="40,130 25,155 55,155" fill="#2a2f3e" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <polygon points="360,130 345,155 375,155" fill="none" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="155" x2="60" y2="155" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <line x1="340" y1="155" x2="380" y2="155" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <!-- Fuerza central -->
            <line x1="200" y1="70" x2="200" y2="128" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="2"/>
            <polygon points="200,130 193,112 207,112" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
            <text x="210" y="90" fill="#ff4d6d" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="13" font-weight="600">F</text>
            <!-- Delta max -->
            <line x1="200" y1="130" x2="200" y2="192" stroke="#3ecf8e" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 2"/>
            <text x="208" y="170" fill="#3ecf8e" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="11">δ_max</text>
            <!-- Labels -->
            <text x="40" y="115" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="10">A</text>
            <text x="355" y="115" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="10">B</text>
            <text x="170" y="240" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="11">← L →</text>
            <line x1="40" y1="235" x2="360" y2="235" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1"/>
            <line x1="40" y1="228" x2="40" y2="242" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1"/>
            <line x1="360" y1="228" x2="360" y2="242" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1"/>
            <!-- Column sketch -->
            <rect x="310" y="50" width="18" height="120" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <rect x="305" y="45" width="28" height="8" fill="#4fa3e0"/>
            <rect x="305" y="170" width="28" height="8" fill="#4fa3e0"/>
            <text x="304" y="42" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="9">Columna</text>
          </svg>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="home-features">
        <div class="feature-item">
          <div class="fi-num">01</div>
          <div class="fi-title">Deflexión en Vigas</div>
          <div class="fi-desc">Voladizo y biapoyada con carga puntual o distribuida</div>
        </div>
        <div class="feature-item">
          <div class="fi-num">02</div>
          <div class="fi-title">Esfuerzo Cortante</div>
          <div class="fi-desc">Corte simple y doble, área requerida</div>
        </div>
        <div class="feature-item">
          <div class="fi-num">03</div>
          <div class="fi-title">Torsión</div>
          <div class="fi-desc">Ángulo de giro, esfuerzo torsional, módulo polar</div>
        </div>
        <div class="feature-item">
          <div class="fi-num">04</div>
          <div class="fi-title">Flexión</div>
          <div class="fi-desc">Esfuerzo de flexión y módulo resistente</div>
        </div>
        <div class="feature-item">
          <div class="fi-num">05</div>
          <div class="fi-title">Columnas (Euler)</div>
          <div class="fi-desc">3 condiciones de contorno, carga crítica</div>
        </div>
        <div class="feature-item">
          <div class="fi-num">06</div>
          <div class="fi-title">Momento de Inercia</div>
          <div class="fi-desc">Rectangular, circular, tubular, perfil I</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ DEFLEXIÓN ============ -->
  <div id="sec-deflexion" class="calc-section">
    <div class="section-header">
      <div class="section-number">01</div>
      <div class="section-info">
        <h2>DEFLEXIÓN EN VIGAS</h2>
        <p>Calcula la deflexión máxima y el ángulo de giro en vigas bajo diferentes condiciones de apoyo y cargas.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="tabs">
      <button class="tab-btn active" onclick="switchTab('def','voladizo')">Viga en Voladizo</button>
      <button class="tab-btn" onclick="switchTab('def','biapoyada')">Viga Biapoyada</button>
      <button class="tab-btn" onclick="switchTab('def','empotrada')">Doblemente Empotrada</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Voladizo -->
    <div id="def-voladizo" class="tab-content active">
      <div class="calc-grid">
        <div>
          <div class="diagram-container">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 380 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-height:180px">
              <rect width="380" height="200" fill="#0d0f14"/>
              <!-- Empotrado -->
              <rect x="10" y="60" width="20" height="80" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="2"/>
              <line x1="10" y1="60" x2="0" y2="50" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <line x1="10" y1="80" x2="0" y2="70" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <line x1="10" y1="100" x2="0" y2="90" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <line x1="10" y1="120" x2="0" y2="110" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <line x1="10" y1="140" x2="0" y2="130" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <!-- Viga -->
              <rect x="30" y="93" width="280" height="14" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <!-- Deflexión -->
              <path d="M 30 100 Q 200 130 310 150" fill="none" stroke="#f4a11d" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
              <!-- Fuerza -->
              <line x1="310" y1="55" x2="310" y2="91" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="2"/>
              <polygon points="310,93 304,75 316,75" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
              <text x="318" y="75" fill="#ff4d6d" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="13" font-weight="600">F</text>
              <!-- L label -->
              <line x1="30" y1="175" x2="310" y2="175" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1"/>
              <line x1="30" y1="168" x2="30" y2="182" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1"/>
              <line x1="310" y1="168" x2="310" y2="182" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1"/>
              <text x="155" y="192" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle">L</text>
              <!-- delta max -->
              <line x1="310" y1="107" x2="310" y2="148" stroke="#3ecf8e" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
              <text x="320" y="135" fill="#3ecf8e" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="10">δmax</text>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="formula-box">
            δ_max = F·L³ / (3·E·I)<br>
            θ = F·L² / (2·E·I)
          </div>
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Parámetros de entrada</div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">F</span> — Fuerza aplicada</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <input type="number" id="def_v_F" placeholder="2200" value="2200">
                <span class="unit-tag">N</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">L</span> — Longitud de la viga</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <input type="number" id="def_v_L" placeholder="500" value="500">
                <span class="unit-tag">mm</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">E</span> — Módulo de elasticidad</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <input type="number" id="def_v_E" placeholder="210000" value="210000">
                <span class="unit-tag">N/mm²</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">I</span> — Momento de inercia (o usa calculadora)</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <input type="number" id="def_v_I" placeholder="8330000" value="8330000">
                <span class="unit-tag">mm⁴</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button class="calc-btn" onclick="calcVoladizo()">CALCULAR DEFLEXIÓN</button>
            <div id="res-voladizo"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">🔧 Calcular I — Sección transversal</div>
            <div class="info-badge">CALCULADORA DE MOMENTO DE INERCIA</div>
            <div class="section-picker">
              <button class="shape-btn active" onclick="selectShapeV('rect')">Rectangular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeV('circ')">Circular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeV('tube')">Tubular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeV('ibeam')">Perfil I</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeV('ptr')">PTR</button>
            </div>
            <div id="shape-inputs-v"></div>
            <button class="calc-btn" style="background:#4fa3e0; margin-top:12px" onclick="calcInercia('v')">CALCULAR I → TRANSFERIR</button>
            <div id="res-inercia-v"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Biapoyada -->
    <div id="def-biapoyada" class="tab-content">
      <div class="calc-grid">
        <div>
          <div class="diagram-container">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 380 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-height:180px">
              <rect width="380" height="200" fill="#0d0f14"/>
              <rect x="20" y="83" width="300" height="14" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <path d="M 20 90 Q 170 130 320 90" fill="none" stroke="#f4a11d" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
              <polygon points="20,97 5,122 35,122" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <line x1="0" y1="122" x2="40" y2="122" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <polygon points="320,97 305,122 335,122" fill="none" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <line x1="300" y1="122" x2="340" y2="122" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <line x1="170" y1="45" x2="170" y2="81" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="2"/>
              <polygon points="170,83 163,65 177,65" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
              <text x="178" y="65" fill="#ff4d6d" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="13" font-weight="600">F</text>
              <line x1="20" y1="155" x2="320" y2="155" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1"/>
              <text x="162" y="172" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="11">L</text>
              <line x1="170" y1="97" x2="170" y2="130" stroke="#3ecf8e" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
              <text x="178" y="120" fill="#3ecf8e" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="10">δmax</text>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="formula-box">
            δ_max = F·L³ / (48·E·I)  [carga central]<br>
            δ_max = 5·w·L⁴ / (384·E·I)  [carga distribuida]<br>
            M_b = F·L / 4  [momento máximo]
          </div>
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Parámetros de entrada</div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label>Tipo de carga</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <select id="def_b_tipo">
                  <option value="puntual">Carga puntual central</option>
                  <option value="distribuida">Carga distribuida</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">F</span> — Fuerza (N) / <span class="var">w</span> — Carga distribuida (N/mm)</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <input type="number" id="def_b_F" placeholder="5000" value="5000">
                <span class="unit-tag">N / N·mm⁻¹</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">L</span> — Longitud</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <input type="number" id="def_b_L" placeholder="800" value="800">
                <span class="unit-tag">mm</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">E</span> — Módulo de elasticidad</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <input type="number" id="def_b_E" placeholder="210000" value="210000">
                <span class="unit-tag">N/mm²</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">I</span> — Momento de inercia</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <input type="number" id="def_b_I" placeholder="8330000" value="8330000">
                <span class="unit-tag">mm⁴</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button class="calc-btn" onclick="calcBiapoyada()">CALCULAR</button>
            <div id="res-biapoyada"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">🔧 Calcular I — Sección transversal</div>
            <div class="info-badge">CALCULADORA DE MOMENTO DE INERCIA</div>
            <div class="section-picker">
              <button class="shape-btn active" onclick="selectShapeB('rect')">Rectangular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeB('circ')">Circular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeB('tube')">Tubular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeB('ibeam')">Perfil I</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeB('ptr')">PTR</button>
            </div>
            <div id="shape-inputs-b"></div>
            <button class="calc-btn" style="background:#4fa3e0; margin-top:12px" onclick="calcInercia('b')">CALCULAR I → TRANSFERIR</button>
            <div id="res-inercia-b"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Doblemente Empotrada -->
    <div id="def-empotrada" class="tab-content">
      <div class="calc-grid">
        <div>
          <div class="diagram-container">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 380 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-height:180px">
              <rect width="380" height="200" fill="#0d0f14"/>
              <!-- Empotrado izq -->
              <rect x="10" y="60" width="18" height="80" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="2"/>
              <line x1="10" y1="65" x2="0" y2="55" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="10" y1="80" x2="0" y2="70" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="10" y1="95" x2="0" y2="85" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="10" y1="110" x2="0" y2="100" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="10" y1="125" x2="0" y2="115" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <!-- Empotrado der -->
              <rect x="320" y="60" width="18" height="80" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="2"/>
              <line x1="338" y1="65" x2="348" y2="55" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="338" y1="80" x2="348" y2="70" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="338" y1="95" x2="348" y2="85" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="338" y1="110" x2="348" y2="100" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="338" y1="125" x2="348" y2="115" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <!-- Viga -->
              <rect x="28" y="88" width="292" height="14" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <!-- Deflexión -->
              <path d="M 28 95 Q 100 115 174 120 Q 248 115 320 95" fill="none" stroke="#f4a11d" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
              <!-- Fuerza central -->
              <line x1="174" y1="50" x2="174" y2="86" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="2"/>
              <polygon points="174,88 167,70 181,70" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
              <text x="182" y="70" fill="#ff4d6d" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="13" font-weight="600">F</text>
              <!-- delta -->
              <line x1="174" y1="102" x2="174" y2="119" stroke="#3ecf8e" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
              <text x="180" y="116" fill="#3ecf8e" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="10">δmax</text>
              <text x="140" y="175" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="11">L</text>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="formula-box">
            δ_max = F·L³ / (192·E·I)  [carga central]<br>
            M_empotrado = F·L / 8<br>
            M_centro = F·L / 8
          </div>
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Parámetros de entrada</div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">F</span> — Fuerza central</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <input type="number" id="def_e_F" placeholder="10000" value="10000">
                <span class="unit-tag">N</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">L</span> — Longitud total</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <input type="number" id="def_e_L" placeholder="600" value="600">
                <span class="unit-tag">mm</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">E</span> — Módulo de elasticidad</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <input type="number" id="def_e_E" placeholder="210000" value="210000">
                <span class="unit-tag">N/mm²</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">I</span> — Momento de inercia</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <input type="number" id="def_e_I" placeholder="8330000" value="8330000">
                <span class="unit-tag">mm⁴</span>
              </div>
            </div>
            <button class="calc-btn" onclick="calcEmpotrada()">CALCULAR</button>
            <div id="res-empotrada"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">🔧 Calcular I — Sección transversal</div>
            <div class="info-badge">CALCULADORA DE MOMENTO DE INERCIA</div>
            <div class="section-picker">
              <button class="shape-btn active" onclick="selectShapeE('rect')">Rectangular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeE('circ')">Circular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeE('tube')">Tubular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeE('ibeam')">Perfil I</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeE('ptr')">PTR</button>
            </div>
            <div id="shape-inputs-e"></div>
            <button class="calc-btn" style="background:#4fa3e0; margin-top:12px" onclick="calcInercia('e')">CALCULAR I → TRANSFERIR</button>
            <div id="res-inercia-e"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  <!-- ============ CORTANTE ============ -->
  <div id="sec-cortante" class="calc-section">
    <div class="section-header">
      <div class="section-number">02</div>
      <div class="section-info">
        <h2>ESFUERZO CORTANTE</h2>
        <p>Calcula el esfuerzo cortante (τ), el área requerida y verifica si la sección resiste la carga.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="calc-grid">
      <div>
        <div class="diagram-container">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 380 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-height:180px">
            <rect width="380" height="200" fill="#0d0f14"/>
            <!-- SINGLE SHEAR -->
            <text x="60" y="25" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Corte Simple</text>
            <rect x="20" y="70" width="40" height="60" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <rect x="60" y="80" width="40" height="40" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <rect x="100" y="70" width="40" height="60" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <circle cx="80" cy="100" r="5" fill="#f4a11d"/>
            <line x1="80" y1="30" x2="80" y2="78" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="2"/>
            <polygon points="80,80 74,62 86,62" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
            <text x="88" y="55" fill="#ff4d6d" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="12">F</text>
            <line x1="60" y1="100" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="#3ecf8e" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 2"/>
            <text x="45" y="160" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="9">S = Área perno</text>
            <!-- DOUBLE SHEAR -->
            <text x="255" y="25" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle">Corte Doble</text>
            <rect x="175" y="65" width="30" height="70" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <rect x="205" y="75" width="30" height="50" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <rect x="235" y="65" width="30" height="70" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <rect x="265" y="75" width="30" height="50" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <rect x="295" y="65" width="30" height="70" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <circle cx="220" cy="100" r="5" fill="#f4a11d"/>
            <circle cx="280" cy="100" r="5" fill="#f4a11d"/>
            <line x1="250" y1="30" x2="250" y2="73" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="2"/>
            <polygon points="250,75 244,57 256,57" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
            <text x="258" y="55" fill="#ff4d6d" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="12">F</text>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="formula-box">
          τ_s = F / S<br>
          S_req = F / τ_sall<br>
          τ_sall = τ_sY / ν  ≈  0.6 · Re / ν
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-title">Parámetros de entrada</div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label>Tipo de corte</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <select id="cort_tipo">
                <option value="simple">Corte simple (single shear)</option>
                <option value="doble">Corte doble (double shear)</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label><span class="var">F</span> — Fuerza de corte</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="cort_F" placeholder="2200" value="2200">
              <span class="unit-tag">N</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label><span class="var">S</span> — Área de la sección (dejar 0 para calcular)</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="cort_S" placeholder="28.3" value="28.3">
              <span class="unit-tag">mm²</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <hr class="divider">
          <div class="info-badge">VERIFICACIÓN DE RESISTENCIA</div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label><span class="var">Re</span> — Resistencia a la fluencia del material</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="cort_Re" placeholder="245" value="245">
              <span class="unit-tag">N/mm²</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label><span class="var">ν</span> — Factor de seguridad</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="cort_v" placeholder="1.5" value="1.5" step="0.1">
              <span class="unit-tag">—</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button class="calc-btn" onclick="calcCortante()">CALCULAR ESFUERZO CORTANTE</button>
          <div id="res-cortante"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-title">🔧 Calcular área de sección circular</div>
          <div class="info-badge">PASADOR / PERNO CIRCULAR</div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label><span class="var">d</span> — Diámetro del pasador</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="cort_d" placeholder="6" value="6">
              <span class="unit-tag">mm</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button class="calc-btn" style="background:#4fa3e0;" onclick="calcAreaCircular()">CALCULAR ÁREA → TRANSFERIR</button>
          <div id="res-area-circ"></div>
          <hr class="divider">
          <div class="card-title">Tabla de materiales comunes</div>
          <div style="font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--text-dim); line-height:2">
            <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:4px;">
              <span style="color:var(--text)">S275J0 (acero)</span><span>Re = 275 N/mm²</span>
              <span style="color:var(--text)">S235</span><span>Re = 235 N/mm²</span>
              <span style="color:var(--text)">S355</span><span>Re = 355 N/mm²</span>
              <span style="color:var(--text)">Aluminio 6061</span><span>Re = 276 N/mm²</span>
              <span style="color:var(--text)">Acero inox. 304</span><span>Re = 210 N/mm²</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ TORSIÓN ============ -->
  <div id="sec-torsion" class="calc-section">
    <div class="section-header">
      <div class="section-number">03</div>
      <div class="section-info">
        <h2>TORSIÓN</h2>
        <p>Calcula el esfuerzo torsional, el módulo polar de sección resistente, el ángulo de giro y la deformación.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="calc-grid">
      <div>
        <div class="diagram-container">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 380 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-height:180px">
            <rect width="380" height="200" fill="#0d0f14"/>
            <!-- Shaft body -->
            <ellipse cx="80" cy="100" rx="20" ry="50" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <rect x="80" y="50" width="200" height="100" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <ellipse cx="280" cy="100" rx="20" ry="50" fill="#161920" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <!-- Torque arrows -->
            <path d="M 50,75 A 30,30 0 0,1 50,125" fill="none" stroke="#f4a11d" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#arrowT)"/>
            <path d="M 310,125 A 30,30 0 0,1 310,75" fill="none" stroke="#f4a11d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
            <defs>
              <marker id="arrowT" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" refX="6" refY="4" orient="auto">
                <path d="M0,0 L8,4 L0,8 Z" fill="#f4a11d"/>
              </marker>
            </defs>
            <text x="20" y="100" fill="#f4a11d" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="12" font-weight="600">Mt</text>
            <text x="316" y="100" fill="#f4a11d" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="12" font-weight="600">Mt</text>
            <!-- Torsional stress lines -->
            <path d="M 80 60 Q 180 55 280 60" fill="none" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 2"/>
            <text x="160" y="48" fill="#ff4d6d" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="10">τt = Mt / Wp</text>
            <!-- d label -->
            <line x1="295" y1="50" x2="295" y2="150" stroke="#3ecf8e" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
            <text x="302" y="105" fill="#3ecf8e" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="11">d</text>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="formula-box">
          τ_t = Mt / Wp<br>
          Wp = π·d³ / 16  [sección sólida]<br>
          Wp = π·(D⁴-d⁴) / (16·D)  [sección hueca]<br>
          φ = Mt·L / (G·Ip)  [ángulo de giro]<br>
          Ip = π·d⁴ / 32  [momento polar]
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-title">Parámetros de entrada</div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label>Tipo de sección</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <select id="tors_tipo" onchange="toggleTorsionInputs()">
                <option value="solida">Sección sólida (eje macizo)</option>
                <option value="hueca">Sección hueca (tubo)</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label><span class="var">d</span> — Diámetro (exterior si es hueca)</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="tors_d" placeholder="32" value="32">
              <span class="unit-tag">mm</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="input-group" id="tors_di_group" style="display:none">
            <label><span class="var">di</span> — Diámetro interior (sección hueca)</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="tors_di" placeholder="20" value="20">
              <span class="unit-tag">mm</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label><span class="var">Mt</span> — Momento torsor</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="tors_Mt" placeholder="420000" value="420000">
              <span class="unit-tag">N·mm</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label><span class="var">L</span> — Longitud del eje</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="tors_L" placeholder="500" value="500">
              <span class="unit-tag">mm</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label><span class="var">G</span> — Módulo de cortante (acero ≈ 80,000)</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="tors_G" placeholder="80000" value="80000">
              <span class="unit-tag">N/mm²</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label><span class="var">Re</span> — Resistencia a la fluencia</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="tors_Re" placeholder="245" value="245">
              <span class="unit-tag">N/mm²</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label><span class="var">ν</span> — Factor de seguridad</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="tors_v" placeholder="1.5" value="1.5" step="0.1">
              <span class="unit-tag">—</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button class="calc-btn" onclick="calcTorsion()">CALCULAR TORSIÓN</button>
          <div id="res-torsion"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="card" style="background: #0d0f14; border-color: var(--accent)">
          <div class="card-title">📌 Referencia rápida</div>
          <div style="font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--text-dim); line-height:1.9">
            <div style="color:var(--text); font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px">Módulo de cortante G</div>
            <div>Acero: G ≈ 80,000 N/mm²</div>
            <div>Aluminio: G ≈ 26,000 N/mm²</div>
            <div>Cobre: G ≈ 45,000 N/mm²</div>
            <div>Hierro fundido: G ≈ 40,000 N/mm²</div>
            <hr style="border-color:var(--border); margin: 12px 0">
            <div style="color:var(--text); font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px">Límite de fluencia torsional</div>
            <div>τ_sY ≈ 0.65 · Re (acero)</div>
            <div>τ_sall = τ_sY / ν</div>
            <hr style="border-color:var(--border); margin: 12px 0">
            <div style="color:var(--text); font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px">Ángulo de giro φ</div>
            <div>φ = Mt · L / (G · Ip)</div>
            <div>Ip = π·d⁴ / 32 (sólido)</div>
            <div>Ip = π·(D⁴-d⁴)/32 (hueco)</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ FLEXIÓN ============ -->
  <div id="sec-flexion" class="calc-section">
    <div class="section-header">
      <div class="section-number">04</div>
      <div class="section-info">
        <h2>ESFUERZO DE FLEXIÓN</h2>
        <p>Calcula el esfuerzo de flexión máximo, el módulo resistente requerido y verifica la resistencia.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="calc-grid">
      <div>
        <div class="diagram-container">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 380 180" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-height:160px">
            <rect width="380" height="180" fill="#0d0f14"/>
            <!-- Viga -->
            <rect x="30" y="70" width="300" height="20" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#2a2f3e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <!-- Neutro -->
            <line x1="30" y1="80" x2="330" y2="80" stroke="#8891a8" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="8 3"/>
            <!-- Tensión arriba -->
            <line x1="50" y1="70" x2="50" y2="40" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
            <line x1="310" y1="70" x2="310" y2="40" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
            <text x="80" y="52" fill="#ff4d6d" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="10">σb tensión (+)</text>
            <!-- Compresión abajo -->
            <line x1="50" y1="90" x2="50" y2="120" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
            <line x1="310" y1="90" x2="310" y2="120" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="3 2"/>
            <text x="80" y="135" fill="#4fa3e0" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="10">σb compresión (-)</text>
            <!-- Fuerza -->
            <line x1="180" y1="20" x2="180" y2="68" stroke="#f4a11d" stroke-width="2"/>
            <polygon points="180,70 174,52 186,52" fill="#f4a11d"/>
            <text x="188" y="42" fill="#f4a11d" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="12" font-weight="600">F</text>
            <!-- Apoyos -->
            <polygon points="30,90 15,110 45,110" fill="none" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <polygon points="330,90 315,110 345,110" fill="none" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
          </svg>
        </div>
        <div class="formula-box">
          σ_b = Mb / W<br>
          W_req = Mb / σ_ball<br>
          σ_ball = σ_bY / ν  ≈  1.2 · Re / ν
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-title">Parámetros de entrada</div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label>Forma de ingresar el momento flector</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <select id="flex_modo" onchange="toggleFlexMode()">
                <option value="directo">Ingresar Mb directamente</option>
                <option value="calcular">Calcular Mb desde F y L</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div id="flex_mb_direct">
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">Mb</span> — Momento flector máximo</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <input type="number" id="flex_Mb" placeholder="1000000" value="1000000">
                <span class="unit-tag">N·mm</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div id="flex_mb_calc" style="display:none">
            <div class="inputs-2col">
              <div class="input-group">
                <label><span class="var">F</span> — Fuerza</label>
                <div class="input-row"><input type="number" id="flex_F" placeholder="5000" value="5000"><span class="unit-tag">N</span></div>
              </div>
              <div class="input-group">
                <label><span class="var">L</span> — Longitud</label>
                <div class="input-row"><input type="number" id="flex_L" placeholder="400" value="400"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label>Tipo de viga para Mb</label>
              <div class="input-row">
                <select id="flex_tipo_viga">
                  <option value="voladizo">Voladizo: Mb = F·L</option>
                  <option value="biapoyada">Biapoyada: Mb = F·L/4</option>
                  <option value="empotrada">Dob. empotrada: Mb = F·L/8</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label><span class="var">W</span> — Módulo resistente axial (dejar 0 para calcular)</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="flex_W" placeholder="0" value="0">
              <span class="unit-tag">mm³</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label><span class="var">Re</span> — Resistencia a la fluencia</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="flex_Re" placeholder="245" value="245">
              <span class="unit-tag">N/mm²</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="input-group">
            <label><span class="var">ν</span> — Factor de seguridad</label>
            <div class="input-row">
              <input type="number" id="flex_v" placeholder="1.5" value="1.5" step="0.1">
              <span class="unit-tag">—</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button class="calc-btn" onclick="calcFlexion()">CALCULAR FLEXIÓN</button>
          <div id="res-flexion"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-title">🔧 Calcular W — Módulo resistente axial</div>
          <div class="info-badge">SECCIÓN TRANSVERSAL</div>
          <div class="section-picker">
            <button class="shape-btn active" onclick="selectShapeW('rect')">Rectangular</button>
            <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeW('circ')">Circular</button>
            <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeW('tube')">Tubular</button>
            <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeW('ibeam')">Perfil I</button>
            <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeW('ptr')">PTR</button>
          </div>
          <div id="shape-inputs-w"></div>
          <button class="calc-btn" style="background:#4fa3e0; margin-top:12px" onclick="calcModuloW()">CALCULAR W → TRANSFERIR</button>
          <div id="res-modulo-w"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ COLUMNAS ============ -->
  <div id="sec-columnas" class="calc-section">
    <div class="section-header">
      <div class="section-number">05</div>
      <div class="section-info">
        <h2>COLUMNAS — CARGA CRÍTICA (EULER)</h2>
        <p>Calcula la carga crítica de pandeo de Euler para los tres casos principales de condiciones de contorno.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="tabs">
      <button class="tab-btn active" onclick="switchTab('col','caso1')">Caso I — Ambos apoyados</button>
      <button class="tab-btn" onclick="switchTab('col','caso2')">Caso II — Emp. + Libre</button>
      <button class="tab-btn" onclick="switchTab('col','caso3')">Caso III — Ambos empotrados</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Caso 1 -->
    <div id="col-caso1" class="tab-content active">
      <div class="calc-grid">
        <div>
          <div class="diagram-container">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 380 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-height:200px">
              <rect width="380" height="220" fill="#0d0f14"/>
              <text x="190" y="22" fill="#f4a11d" font-family="Bebas Neue" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="2">CASO I: Lef = L</text>
              <!-- Column -->
              <rect x="165" y="40" width="30" height="140" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="2"/>
              <!-- Pinned top -->
              <circle cx="180" cy="40" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#3ecf8e" stroke-width="2"/>
              <!-- Pinned bottom -->
              <polygon points="180,182 165,202 195,202" fill="none" stroke="#3ecf8e" stroke-width="2"/>
              <line x1="155" y1="202" x2="205" y2="202" stroke="#3ecf8e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
              <!-- Force arrow -->
              <line x1="180" y1="8" x2="180" y2="32" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
              <polygon points="180,34 173,16 187,16" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
              <text x="188" y="22" fill="#ff4d6d" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="12" font-weight="600">Fcr</text>
              <!-- Buckling shape -->
              <path d="M 180 40 Q 215 110 180 182" fill="none" stroke="#f4a11d" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
              <!-- Lef label -->
              <line x1="210" y1="40" x2="230" y2="40" stroke="#8891a8" stroke-width="1"/>
              <line x1="210" y1="182" x2="230" y2="182" stroke="#8891a8" stroke-width="1"/>
              <line x1="220" y1="40" x2="220" y2="182" stroke="#8891a8" stroke-width="1"/>
              <text x="228" y="115" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="10">Lef=L</text>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="formula-box">
            F_cr = π²·E·I / (L_ef)²<br>
            L_ef = L  (ambos articulados)<br>
            λ = L_ef / i,  i = √(I/A)  (esbeltez)
          </div>
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Parámetros — Caso I</div>
            <ColInputs prefix="c1"/>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">E</span> — Módulo de elasticidad</label>
              <div class="input-row"><input type="number" id="col1_E" placeholder="210000" value="210000"><span class="unit-tag">N/mm²</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">I</span> — Momento de inercia mínimo</label>
              <div class="input-row"><input type="number" id="col1_I" placeholder="8330000" value="8330000"><span class="unit-tag">mm⁴</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">L</span> — Longitud de la columna</label>
              <div class="input-row"><input type="number" id="col1_L" placeholder="2000" value="2000"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">A</span> — Área transversal (para esbeltez)</label>
              <div class="input-row"><input type="number" id="col1_A" placeholder="3000" value="3000"><span class="unit-tag">mm²</span></div>
            </div>
            <button class="calc-btn" onclick="calcColumna(1, 1.0)">CALCULAR CARGA CRÍTICA</button>
            <div id="res-col1"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">🔧 Calcular I — Sección transversal</div>
            <div class="info-badge">MOMENTO DE INERCIA</div>
            <div class="section-picker">
              <button class="shape-btn active" onclick="selectShapeC1('rect')">Rectangular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeC1('circ')">Circular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeC1('tube')">Tubular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeC1('ibeam')">Perfil I</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeC1('ptr')">PTR</button>
            </div>
            <div id="shape-inputs-c1"></div>

            <div id="res-inercia-c1"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Caso 2 -->
    <div id="col-caso2" class="tab-content">
      <div class="calc-grid">
        <div>
          <div class="diagram-container">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 380 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-height:200px">
              <rect width="380" height="220" fill="#0d0f14"/>
              <text x="190" y="22" fill="#f4a11d" font-family="Bebas Neue" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="2">CASO II: Lef = 2L</text>
              <!-- Column empotrado en base -->
              <rect x="162" y="60" width="36" height="140" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="2"/>
              <!-- Empotrado base -->
              <rect x="150" y="200" width="60" height="12" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="2"/>
              <line x1="150" y1="212" x2="140" y2="222" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="163" y1="212" x2="153" y2="222" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="176" y1="212" x2="166" y2="222" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="189" y1="212" x2="179" y2="222" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="202" y1="212" x2="192" y2="222" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <!-- Free top -->
              <line x1="145" y1="60" x2="225" y2="60" stroke="#3ecf8e" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 2"/>
              <!-- Force -->
              <line x1="180" y1="12" x2="180" y2="52" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="2.5"/>
              <polygon points="180,56 173,36 187,36" fill="#ff4d6d"/>
              <text x="188" y="36" fill="#ff4d6d" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="12" font-weight="600">Fcr</text>
              <!-- Buckling -->
              <path d="M 180 60 Q 215 130 180 200" fill="none" stroke="#f4a11d" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
              <!-- Lef label -->

              <line x1="218" y1="200" x2="238" y2="200" stroke="#8891a8" stroke-width="1"/>
              <line x1="228" y1="60" x2="228" y2="200" stroke="#8891a8" stroke-width="1"/>
              <text x="235" y="135" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="10">Lef=2L</text>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="formula-box">
            F_cr = π²·E·I / (L_ef)²<br>
            L_ef = 2·L  (empotrado-libre)<br>

          </div>

            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">L</span> — Longitud de la columna</label>
              <div class="input-row"><input type="number" id="col2_L" placeholder="2000" value="2000"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">A</span> — Área transversal</label>

            </div>
            <button class="calc-btn" onclick="calcColumna(2, 2.0)">CALCULAR CARGA CRÍTICA</button>
            <div id="res-col2"></div>

        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="card">

            <div class="section-picker">

              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeC2('circ')">Circular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeC2('tube')">Tubular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeC2('ibeam')">Perfil I</button>

            <button class="calc-btn" style="background:#4fa3e0; margin-top:12px" onclick="calcInercia('c2')">CALCULAR I → TRANSFERIR</button>

    <!-- Caso 3 -->
    <div id="col-caso3" class="tab-content">
      <div class="calc-grid">
        <div>
          <div class="diagram-container">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 380 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-height:200px">
              <rect width="380" height="220" fill="#0d0f14"/>
              <text x="190" y="22" fill="#f4a11d" font-family="Bebas Neue" font-size="14" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="2">CASO III: Lef = 0.5L</text>
              <rect x="162" y="40" width="36" height="155" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="2"/>
              <!-- Empotrado top -->
              <rect x="148" y="28" width="64" height="12" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="2"/>
              <line x1="150" y1="28" x2="140" y2="18" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="165" y1="28" x2="155" y2="18" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="180" y1="28" x2="170" y2="18" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="195" y1="28" x2="185" y2="18" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="210" y1="28" x2="200" y2="18" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <!-- Empotrado base -->
              <rect x="148" y="195" width="64" height="12" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="2"/>
              <line x1="150" y1="207" x2="140" y2="217" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="165" y1="207" x2="155" y2="217" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="180" y1="207" x2="170" y2="217" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="195" y1="207" x2="185" y2="217" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <line x1="210" y1="207" x2="200" y2="217" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
              <!-- Force -->
              <line x1="180" y1="40" x2="180" y2="14" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="0"/>
              <!-- Buckling (S-shape) -->
              <path d="M 180 40 Q 215 90 180 118 Q 145 145 180 195" fill="none" stroke="#f4a11d" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>
              <!-- Lef label -->
              <line x1="215" y1="40" x2="235" y2="40" stroke="#8891a8" stroke-width="1"/>
              <line x1="215" y1="195" x2="235" y2="195" stroke="#8891a8" stroke-width="1"/>
              <line x1="225" y1="40" x2="225" y2="195" stroke="#8891a8" stroke-width="1"/>
              <text x="232" y="122" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="10">Lef=0.5L</text>
            </svg>
          </div>
          <div class="formula-box">
            F_cr = π²·E·I / (L_ef)²<br>
            L_ef = 0.5·L  (ambos empotrados)<br>
            ← Condición más favorable
          </div>
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">Parámetros — Caso III</div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">E</span> — Módulo de elasticidad</label>
              <div class="input-row"><input type="number" id="col3_E" placeholder="210000" value="210000"><span class="unit-tag">N/mm²</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">I</span> — Momento de inercia mínimo</label>
              <div class="input-row"><input type="number" id="col3_I" placeholder="8330000" value="8330000"><span class="unit-tag">mm⁴</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">L</span> — Longitud de la columna</label>
              <div class="input-row"><input type="number" id="col3_L" placeholder="2000" value="2000"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="input-group">
              <label><span class="var">A</span> — Área transversal</label>
              <div class="input-row"><input type="number" id="col3_A" placeholder="3000" value="3000"><span class="unit-tag">mm²</span></div>
            </div>
            <button class="calc-btn" onclick="calcColumna(3, 0.5)">CALCULAR CARGA CRÍTICA</button>
            <div id="res-col3"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-title">🔧 Calcular I — Sección transversal</div>
            <div class="info-badge">MOMENTO DE INERCIA</div>
            <div class="section-picker">
              <button class="shape-btn active" onclick="selectShapeC3('rect')">Rectangular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeC3('circ')">Circular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeC3('tube')">Tubular</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeC3('ibeam')">Perfil I</button>
              <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeC3('ptr')">PTR</button>
            </div>
            <div id="shape-inputs-c3"></div>
            <button class="calc-btn" style="background:#4fa3e0; margin-top:12px" onclick="calcInercia('c3')">CALCULAR I → TRANSFERIR</button>
            <div id="res-inercia-c3"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ============ INERCIA ============ -->
  <div id="sec-inercia" class="calc-section">
    <div class="section-header">
      <div class="section-number">06</div>
      <div class="section-info">
        <h2>MOMENTO DE INERCIA</h2>
        <p>Calcula el momento de inercia y el módulo resistente axial y polar para secciones transversales estándar.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="calc-grid">
      <div>
        <div class="diagram-container">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 380 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="width:100%; max-height:180px">
            <rect width="380" height="200" fill="#0d0f14"/>
            <!-- Rectangular -->
            <text x="50" y="20" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Rectangular</text>
            <rect x="20" y="30" width="60" height="90" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#f4a11d" stroke-width="2"/>
            <line x1="20" y1="75" x2="80" y2="75" stroke="#8891a8" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4 2"/>
            <text x="85" y="38" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="8">h</text>
            <text x="47" y="128" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="8">b</text>
            <!-- Circle -->
            <text x="150" y="20" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Circular</text>
            <circle cx="150" cy="75" r="40" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="2"/>
            <line x1="110" y1="75" x2="190" y2="75" stroke="#8891a8" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4 2"/>
            <text x="153" y="73" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="8">d</text>
            <!-- Tube -->
            <text x="255" y="20" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Tubular</text>
            <circle cx="255" cy="75" r="40" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#3ecf8e" stroke-width="2"/>
            <circle cx="255" cy="75" r="24" fill="#0d0f14" stroke="#3ecf8e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <text x="258" y="53" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="8">D</text>
            <text x="258" y="70" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="8">d</text>
            <!-- I beam -->
            <text x="335" y="20" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">Perfil I</text>
            <rect x="307" y="30" width="56" height="10" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <rect x="325" y="40" width="20" height="60" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <rect x="307" y="100" width="56" height="10" fill="#1e2230" stroke="#ff4d6d" stroke-width="1.5"/>
            <!-- Formulas -->
            <text x="10" y="155" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="8">I = b·h³/12</text>
            <text x="110" y="155" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="8">I = π·d⁴/64</text>
            <text x="210" y="155" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="8">I=π(D⁴-d⁴)/64</text>
            <text x="300" y="155" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="8">Steiner+partes</text>
          </svg>
        </div>

          <div class="card-title">Seleccionar sección</div>
          <div class="section-picker">
            <button class="shape-btn active" onclick="selectShapeI('rect')">Rectangular</button>
            <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeI('circ')">Circular</button>
            <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeI('tube')">Tubular</button>
            <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeI('ibeam')">Perfil I</button>
            <button class="shape-btn" onclick="selectShapeI('ptr')">PTR</button>
          </div>
          <div id="shape-inputs-i"></div>
          <button class="calc-btn" onclick="calcInerciaMain()">CALCULAR MOMENTO DE INERCIA</button>
