        <div class="card" style="background:#0d0f14; border-color:var(--accent)">
          <div class="card-title">📌 Fórmulas de referencia</div>
          <div class="formula-box" style="margin-bottom:12px">
            <strong style="color:var(--text)">Rectangular (b×h):</strong><br>
            I = b·h³/12<br>
            W = b·h²/6
          </div>
          <div class="formula-box" style="margin-bottom:12px">
            <strong style="color:var(--text)">Circular (diámetro d):</strong><br>
            I = π·d⁴/64<br>
            W = π·d³/32<br>
            Wp = π·d³/16  (polar)
          </div>
          <div class="formula-box" style="margin-bottom:12px">
            <strong style="color:var(--text)">Tubular (D ext., d int.):</strong><br>
            I = π·(D⁴-d⁴)/64<br>
            W = π·(D⁴-d⁴)/(32·D)<br>
            Wp = π·(D⁴-d⁴)/(16·D)
          </div>
          <div class="formula-box">
            <strong style="color:var(--text)">PTR — Perfil Tubular Rectangular (B×H×t):</strong><br>
            Ix = (B·H³ - bi·hi³) / 12<br>
            Iy = (H·B³ - hi·bi³) / 12<br>
            Wx = Ix / (H/2),  bi = B-2t,  hi = H-2t<br>
            A = B·H - bi·hi
          </div>
          <div class="formula-box">
            <strong style="color:var(--text)">Perfil I (b_f, t_f, h_w, t_w):</strong><br>
            I = b_f·H³/12 - (b_f-t_w)·h_w³/12<br>
            W = I / (H/2)
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div><!-- end main -->

<script>
// ===================== NAVIGATION =====================
function showSection(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.calc-section').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('visible'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.menu-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById('sec-' + id).classList.add('visible');
  const btns = document.querySelectorAll('.menu-btn');
  const sectionIndex = ['home','deflexion','cortante','torsion','flexion','columnas','inercia'].indexOf(id);
  if (sectionIndex >= 0) btns[sectionIndex].classList.add('active');
}

function switchTab(group, tab) {
  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll(`[id^="${group}-"]`);
  tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
  const btns = document.querySelectorAll(`.tabs .tab-btn`);
  // Find buttons in the same parent
  const el = document.getElementById(group + '-' + tab);
  if (!el) return;
  el.classList.add('active');
  // Update tab buttons
  const parentTabs = el.closest('.calc-section') || el.parentElement.parentElement;
  const tabBtns = parentTabs.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn');
  tabBtns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  const idx = [...tabs].indexOf(el);
  if (tabBtns[idx]) tabBtns[idx].classList.add('active');
}

// ===================== SHAPE INPUTS =====================
function getShapeInputsHTML(shape) {
  const inputs = {
    rect: `<div class="inputs-2col">
      <div class="input-group"><label><span class="var">b</span> — Base</label>
        <div class="input-row"><input type="number" class="sh-b" placeholder="50" value="50"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div></div>
      <div class="input-group"><label><span class="var">h</span> — Altura</label>
        <div class="input-row"><input type="number" class="sh-h" placeholder="100" value="100"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div></div>
    </div>`,
    circ: `<div class="input-group"><label><span class="var">d</span> — Diámetro</label>
      <div class="input-row"><input type="number" class="sh-d" placeholder="50" value="50"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div></div>`,
    tube: `<div class="inputs-2col">
      <div class="input-group"><label><span class="var">D</span> — Diám. exterior</label>
        <div class="input-row"><input type="number" class="sh-D" placeholder="60" value="60"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div></div>
      <div class="input-group"><label><span class="var">d</span> — Diám. interior</label>
        <div class="input-row"><input type="number" class="sh-d" placeholder="40" value="40"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div></div>
    </div>`,
    ibeam: `<div class="inputs-2col">
      <div class="input-group"><label><span class="var">bf</span> — Ancho ala</label>
        <div class="input-row"><input type="number" class="sh-bf" placeholder="100" value="100"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div></div>
      <div class="input-group"><label><span class="var">tf</span> — Espesor ala</label>
        <div class="input-row"><input type="number" class="sh-tf" placeholder="10" value="10"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div></div>
      <div class="input-group"><label><span class="var">hw</span> — Altura alma</label>
        <div class="input-row"><input type="number" class="sh-hw" placeholder="180" value="180"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div></div>
      <div class="input-group"><label><span class="var">tw</span> — Espesor alma</label>
        <div class="input-row"><input type="number" class="sh-tw" placeholder="6" value="6"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div></div>
    </div>`,
    ptr: `
      <div style="background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:12px;margin-bottom:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 90 70" width="90" height="70" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
          <rect x="4" y="4" width="82" height="62" fill="none" stroke="#f4a11d" stroke-width="3" rx="4"/>
          <rect x="14" y="14" width="62" height="42" fill="none" stroke="#4fa3e0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="4 2" rx="2"/>
          <text x="45" y="8" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="8" text-anchor="middle">B (base ext.)</text>
          <text x="92" y="38" fill="#8891a8" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="8" text-anchor="start" transform="rotate(90,88,38)" style="transform-origin:88px 38px">H (alt ext.)</text>
          <text x="45" y="42" fill="#4fa3e0" font-family="IBM Plex Mono" font-size="7" text-anchor="middle">t = espesor</text>
        </svg>
        <div style="font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--text-dim);line-height:1.8">
          <div>Ix = (B·H³ - bi·hi³) / 12</div>
          <div>Iy = (H·B³ - hi·bi³) / 12</div>
          <div>bi = B - 2t,  hi = H - 2t</div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="inputs-2col">
        <div class="input-group"><label><span class="var">B</span> — Base exterior</label>
          <div class="input-row"><input type="number" class="sh-ptr-B" placeholder="100" value="100"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div></div>
        <div class="input-group"><label><span class="var">H</span> — Altura exterior</label>
          <div class="input-row"><input type="number" class="sh-ptr-H" placeholder="60" value="60"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div></div>
        <div class="input-group"><label><span class="var">t</span> — Espesor de pared</label>
          <div class="input-row"><input type="number" class="sh-ptr-t" placeholder="4" value="4"><span class="unit-tag">mm</span></div></div>
      </div>
      <div style="font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-top:6px;padding:8px;background:rgba(244,161,29,0.06);border-left:2px solid var(--accent)">
        ⚡ PTR = Perfil Tubular Rectangular (tubo cuadrado/rectangular de acero)
      </div>`
  };
  return inputs[shape] || '';
}

function selectShape(suffix, shape, prefix) {
  document.getElementById('shape-inputs-' + suffix).innerHTML = getShapeInputsHTML(shape);
  const btns = document.getElementById('shape-inputs-' + suffix).parentElement.querySelectorAll('.shape-btn');
  btns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  const shapeNames = ['rect','circ','tube','ibeam'];
  const idx = shapeNames.indexOf(shape);
  if (btns[idx]) btns[idx].classList.add('active');
}

// Generate select functions for each context
['v','b','e','w','c1','c2','c3','i'].forEach(s => {
  window['selectShape' + s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1)] = function(shape) { selectShape(s, shape); };
  // also init on load
});

// Aliases with correct casing
function selectShapeV(s) { selectShape('v', s); }
function selectShapeB(s) { selectShape('b', s); }
function selectShapeE(s) { selectShape('e', s); }
function selectShapeW(s) { selectShape('w', s); }
function selectShapeC1(s) { selectShape('c1', s); }
function selectShapeC2(s) { selectShape('c2', s); }
function selectShapeC3(s) { selectShape('c3', s); }
function selectShapeI(s) { selectShape('i', s); }

function computeI(container) {
  const get = cls => {
    const el = container.querySelector('.' + cls);
    return el ? parseFloat(el.value) || 0 : 0;
  };
  let I = 0, W = 0, Wp = 0, A = 0, Iy = 0;
  if (container.querySelector('.sh-ptr-B')) {
    // PTR - Perfil Tubular Rectangular
    const B = get('sh-ptr-B'), H = get('sh-ptr-H'), t = get('sh-ptr-t');
    const bi = B - 2*t, hi = H - 2*t;
    I  = (B * Math.pow(H,3) - bi * Math.pow(hi,3)) / 12;  // Ix (eje horizontal)
    Iy = (H * Math.pow(B,3) - hi * Math.pow(bi,3)) / 12;  // Iy (eje vertical)
    W  = I / (H/2);
    Wp = 0;
    A  = B*H - bi*hi;
  } else if (container.querySelector('.sh-h')) {
    const b = get('sh-b'), h = get('sh-h');
    I = b * Math.pow(h, 3) / 12;
    W = b * Math.pow(h, 2) / 6;
    Wp = 0; A = b * h;
  } else if (container.querySelector('.sh-D')) {
    const D = get('sh-D'), d = get('sh-d');
    I = Math.PI * (Math.pow(D, 4) - Math.pow(d, 4)) / 64;
    W = Math.PI * (Math.pow(D, 4) - Math.pow(d, 4)) / (32 * D);
    Wp = Math.PI * (Math.pow(D, 4) - Math.pow(d, 4)) / (16 * D);
    A = Math.PI * (D * D - d * d) / 4;
  } else if (container.querySelector('.sh-d')) {
    const d = get('sh-d');
    I = Math.PI * Math.pow(d, 4) / 64;
    W = Math.PI * Math.pow(d, 3) / 32;
    Wp = Math.PI * Math.pow(d, 3) / 16;
    A = Math.PI * d * d / 4;
  } else if (container.querySelector('.sh-bf')) {
    const bf = get('sh-bf'), tf = get('sh-tf'), hw = get('sh-hw'), tw = get('sh-tw');
    const H = hw + 2 * tf;
    I = bf * Math.pow(H, 3) / 12 - (bf - tw) * Math.pow(hw, 3) / 12;
    W = I / (H / 2);
    Wp = 0;
    A = 2 * bf * tf + hw * tw;
  }
  return { I, W, Wp, A, Iy };
}

function calcInercia(suffix) {
  const container = document.getElementById('shape-inputs-' + suffix);
  const { I, W, Wp, A, Iy } = computeI(container);
  let rows = [
    ['Momento de inercia Ix', fmt(I, 4), 'mm⁴'],
    ['Módulo resistente Wx', fmt(W, 3), 'mm³'],
  ];
  if (Iy > 0) rows.push(['Momento de inercia Iy', fmt(Iy, 4), 'mm⁴']);
  if (Wp > 0) {
    rows.push(['Módulo polar Wp', fmt(Wp, 3), 'mm³']);
    rows.push(['Área A', fmt(A, 2), 'mm²']);
  }
  if (A > 0 && !Wp) rows.push(['Área A', fmt(A, 2), 'mm²']);
  document.getElementById('res-inercia-' + suffix).innerHTML = resultCard(rows);

  // Transfer I to relevant input
  const map = { v: 'def_v_I', b: 'def_b_I', e: 'def_e_I', w: 'flex_W', c1: 'col1_I', c2: 'col2_I', c3: 'col3_I' };
  if (map[suffix]) {
    const el = document.getElementById(map[suffix]);
    if (el) { el.value = parseFloat(I.toFixed(2)); }
  }
}

function calcInerciaMain() {
  const container = document.getElementById('shape-inputs-i');
  const { I, W, Wp, A, Iy } = computeI(container);
  const rows = [
    ['Momento de inercia Ix', fmt(I, 4), 'mm⁴'],
    ['Módulo resistente Wx', fmt(W, 3), 'mm³'],
  ];
  if (Iy > 0) rows.push(['Momento de inercia Iy', fmt(Iy, 4), 'mm⁴']);
  if (Wp > 0) rows.push(['Módulo polar Wp', fmt(Wp, 3), 'mm³']);
  rows.push(['Área A', fmt(A, 2), 'mm²']);
  if (A > 0) rows.push(['Radio de giro i', fmt(Math.sqrt(I/A), 2), 'mm']);
  document.getElementById('res-inercia-main').innerHTML = resultCard(rows);
}

// ===================== HELPERS =====================
function fmt(v, dec = 2) {
  if (!isFinite(v) || isNaN(v)) return '—';
  if (Math.abs(v) > 1e6) return v.toExponential(2);
  return v.toFixed(dec).replace(/\.?0+$/, '') || '0';
}

function resultCard(rows) {
  let html = '<div class="result-card">';
  rows.forEach(r => {
    html += `<div class="result-row"><span class="result-label">${r[0]}</span><span class="result-value">${r[1]} <span style="color:var(--text-dim);font-size:0.75rem">${r[2]}</span></span></div>`;
  });
  html += '</div>';
  return html;
}

function resultCardWithStatus(rows, status) {
  let html = '<div class="result-card">';
  rows.forEach(r => {
    const cls = r[3] || '';
    html += `<div class="result-row"><span class="result-label">${r[0]}</span><span class="result-value ${cls}">${r[1]} <span style="color:var(--text-dim);font-size:0.75rem">${r[2]}</span></span></div>`;
  });
  if (status) html += `<div style="margin-top:10px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:0.8rem" class="${status.ok ? 'status-ok' : 'status-fail'}">${status.ok ? '✔ APROBADO' : '✖ FALLA'}: ${status.msg}</div>`;
  html += '</div>';
  return html;
}

// ===================== CALCS =====================

function calcVoladizo() {
  const F = parseFloat(document.getElementById('def_v_F').value);
  const L = parseFloat(document.getElementById('def_v_L').value);
  const E = parseFloat(document.getElementById('def_v_E').value);
  const I = parseFloat(document.getElementById('def_v_I').value);
  if (!F || !L || !E || !I) return;
  const d_max = F * Math.pow(L, 3) / (3 * E * I);
  const theta = F * Math.pow(L, 2) / (2 * E * I);
  const Mb = F * L;
  document.getElementById('res-voladizo').innerHTML = resultCard([
    ['Deflexión máxima δmax', fmt(d_max, 4), 'mm'],
    ['Ángulo de giro θ', fmt(theta * 1000, 4), 'mrad'],
    ['Momento flector máximo Mb', fmt(Mb, 2), 'N·mm'],
    ['Reacción en empotramiento', fmt(F, 2), 'N'],
  ]);
}

function calcBiapoyada() {
  const tipo = document.getElementById('def_b_tipo').value;
  const F = parseFloat(document.getElementById('def_b_F').value);
  const L = parseFloat(document.getElementById('def_b_L').value);
  const E = parseFloat(document.getElementById('def_b_E').value);
  const I = parseFloat(document.getElementById('def_b_I').value);
  if (!F || !L || !E || !I) return;
  let d_max, Mb;
  if (tipo === 'puntual') {
    d_max = F * Math.pow(L, 3) / (48 * E * I);
    Mb = F * L / 4;
  } else {
    d_max = 5 * F * Math.pow(L, 4) / (384 * E * I);
    Mb = F * L * L / 8;
  }
  document.getElementById('res-biapoyada').innerHTML = resultCard([
    ['Deflexión máxima δmax', fmt(d_max, 4), 'mm'],
    ['Momento flector máximo Mb', fmt(Mb, 2), 'N·mm'],
    ['Reacción en apoyos', fmt(tipo==='puntual' ? F/2 : F*L/2, 2), 'N'],
  ]);
}

function calcEmpotrada() {
  const F = parseFloat(document.getElementById('def_e_F').value);
  const L = parseFloat(document.getElementById('def_e_L').value);
  const E = parseFloat(document.getElementById('def_e_E').value);
  const I = parseFloat(document.getElementById('def_e_I').value);
  if (!F || !L || !E || !I) return;
  const d_max = F * Math.pow(L, 3) / (192 * E * I);
  const Mb_emp = F * L / 8;
  const Mb_cen = F * L / 8;
  document.getElementById('res-empotrada').innerHTML = resultCard([
    ['Deflexión máxima δmax', fmt(d_max, 4), 'mm'],
    ['Momento en empotramientos', fmt(Mb_emp, 2), 'N·mm'],
    ['Momento en centro', fmt(Mb_cen, 2), 'N·mm'],
    ['Reacción en apoyos', fmt(F/2, 2), 'N'],
  ]);
}

function calcCortante() {
  const tipo = document.getElementById('cort_tipo').value;
  const F = parseFloat(document.getElementById('cort_F').value);
  const S = parseFloat(document.getElementById('cort_S').value);
  const Re = parseFloat(document.getElementById('cort_Re').value);
  const v = parseFloat(document.getElementById('cort_v').value);
  if (!F) return;
  const divisor = tipo === 'doble' ? 2 : 1;
  const tau_sY = 0.6 * Re;
  const tau_sall = tau_sY / v;
  let rows = [];
  if (S > 0) {
    const tau_s = F / (S * divisor);
    const ok = tau_s <= tau_sall;
    rows = [
      ['Esfuerzo cortante τs', fmt(tau_s, 2), 'N/mm²', ok ? '' : 'danger'],
      ['Esfuerzo admisible τsall', fmt(tau_sall, 2), 'N/mm²'],
      ['Área cortante total', fmt(S * divisor, 2), 'mm²'],
    ];
    document.getElementById('res-cortante').innerHTML = resultCardWithStatus(rows, {
      ok, msg: ok ? `τs=${fmt(tau_s,2)} ≤ τsall=${fmt(tau_sall,2)} N/mm²` : `τs=${fmt(tau_s,2)} > τsall=${fmt(tau_sall,2)} N/mm²`
    });
  } else {
    const S_req = F / (tau_sall * divisor);
    rows = [
      ['Área requerida Sreq', fmt(S_req, 2), 'mm²'],
      ['Esfuerzo admisible τsall', fmt(tau_sall, 2), 'N/mm²'],
      ['τsY (fluencia cortante)', fmt(tau_sY, 2), 'N/mm²'],
    ];
    document.getElementById('res-cortante').innerHTML = resultCard(rows);
  }
}

function calcAreaCircular() {
  const d = parseFloat(document.getElementById('cort_d').value);
  if (!d) return;
  const A = Math.PI * d * d / 4;
  document.getElementById('res-area-circ').innerHTML = resultCard([['Área sección circular', fmt(A, 3), 'mm²']]);
  document.getElementById('cort_S').value = A.toFixed(3);
}

function toggleTorsionInputs() {
  const tipo = document.getElementById('tors_tipo').value;
  document.getElementById('tors_di_group').style.display = tipo === 'hueca' ? 'block' : 'none';
}

function calcTorsion() {
  const tipo = document.getElementById('tors_tipo').value;
  const d = parseFloat(document.getElementById('tors_d').value);
  const di = tipo === 'hueca' ? parseFloat(document.getElementById('tors_di').value) : 0;
  const Mt = parseFloat(document.getElementById('tors_Mt').value);
  const L = parseFloat(document.getElementById('tors_L').value);
  const G = parseFloat(document.getElementById('tors_G').value);
  const Re = parseFloat(document.getElementById('tors_Re').value);
  const v = parseFloat(document.getElementById('tors_v').value);
  if (!d || !Mt) return;
  let Wp, Ip;
  if (tipo === 'solida') {
    Wp = Math.PI * Math.pow(d, 3) / 16;
    Ip = Math.PI * Math.pow(d, 4) / 32;
  } else {
    Wp = Math.PI * (Math.pow(d, 4) - Math.pow(di, 4)) / (16 * d);
    Ip = Math.PI * (Math.pow(d, 4) - Math.pow(di, 4)) / 32;
  }
  const tau_t = Mt / Wp;
  const tau_tY = 0.65 * Re;
  const tau_tall = tau_tY / v;
  const phi = (L && G) ? Mt * L / (G * Ip) : null;
  const phi_deg = phi ? phi * 180 / Math.PI : null;
  const ok = tau_t <= tau_tall;
  const rows = [
    ['Módulo polar Wp', fmt(Wp, 2), 'mm³'],
    ['Momento polar Ip', fmt(Ip, 2), 'mm⁴'],
    ['Esfuerzo torsional τt', fmt(tau_t, 2), 'N/mm²', ok ? '' : 'danger'],
    ['τt admisible (τtall)', fmt(tau_tall, 2), 'N/mm²'],
  ];
  if (phi !== null) {
    rows.push(['Ángulo de giro φ', fmt(phi * 1000, 4), 'mrad']);
    rows.push(['Ángulo de giro φ', fmt(phi_deg, 4), '°']);
  }
  document.getElementById('res-torsion').innerHTML = resultCardWithStatus(rows, {
    ok, msg: ok ? `τt=${fmt(tau_t,2)} ≤ τtall=${fmt(tau_tall,2)} N/mm²` : `τt=${fmt(tau_t,2)} > τtall=${fmt(tau_tall,2)} N/mm²`
  });
}

function toggleFlexMode() {
  const modo = document.getElementById('flex_modo').value;
  document.getElementById('flex_mb_direct').style.display = modo === 'directo' ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('flex_mb_calc').style.display = modo === 'calcular' ? 'block' : 'none';
}

function calcFlexion() {
  const modo = document.getElementById('flex_modo').value;
  let Mb;
  if (modo === 'directo') {
    Mb = parseFloat(document.getElementById('flex_Mb').value);
  } else {
    const F = parseFloat(document.getElementById('flex_F').value);
    const L = parseFloat(document.getElementById('flex_L').value);
    const tipo = document.getElementById('flex_tipo_viga').value;
    if (tipo === 'voladizo') Mb = F * L;
    else if (tipo === 'biapoyada') Mb = F * L / 4;
    else Mb = F * L / 8;
  }
  const W = parseFloat(document.getElementById('flex_W').value);
  const Re = parseFloat(document.getElementById('flex_Re').value);
  const v = parseFloat(document.getElementById('flex_v').value);
  if (!Mb || !Re) return;
  const sigma_bY = 1.2 * Re;
  const sigma_ball = sigma_bY / v;
  const rows = [['Momento flector Mb', fmt(Mb, 2), 'N·mm'], ['σball admisible', fmt(sigma_ball, 2), 'N/mm²']];
  if (W > 0) {
    const sigma_b = Mb / W;
    const ok = sigma_b <= sigma_ball;
    rows.push(['Esfuerzo de flexión σb', fmt(sigma_b, 2), 'N/mm²', ok ? '' : 'danger']);
    document.getElementById('res-flexion').innerHTML = resultCardWithStatus(rows, {
      ok, msg: ok ? `σb=${fmt(sigma_b,2)} ≤ σball=${fmt(sigma_ball,2)} N/mm²` : `σb=${fmt(sigma_b,2)} > σball=${fmt(sigma_ball,2)} N/mm²`
    });
  } else {
    const W_req = Mb / sigma_ball;
    rows.push(['Módulo resistente requerido Wreq', fmt(W_req, 2), 'mm³']);
    document.getElementById('res-flexion').innerHTML = resultCard(rows);
  }
}

function calcModuloW() {
  const container = document.getElementById('shape-inputs-w');
  const { I, W, Wp, Iy } = computeI(container);
  const rows = [
    ['Módulo resistente Wx', fmt(W, 3), 'mm³'],
    ['Momento de inercia Ix', fmt(I, 4), 'mm⁴'],
  ];
  if (Iy > 0) rows.push(['Momento de inercia Iy', fmt(Iy, 4), 'mm⁴']);
  document.getElementById('res-modulo-w').innerHTML = resultCard(rows);
  document.getElementById('flex_W').value = parseFloat(W.toFixed(2));
}

function calcColumna(caso, factor) {
  const E = parseFloat(document.getElementById('col' + caso + '_E').value);
  const I = parseFloat(document.getElementById('col' + caso + '_I').value);
  const L = parseFloat(document.getElementById('col' + caso + '_L').value);
  const A = parseFloat(document.getElementById('col' + caso + '_A').value);
  if (!E || !I || !L) return;
  const Lef = factor * L;
  const Fcr = Math.PI * Math.PI * E * I / (Lef * Lef);
  const i = A ? Math.sqrt(I / A) : null;
  const lambda = i ? Lef / i : null;
  const rows = [
    ['Longitud efectiva Lef', fmt(Lef, 2), 'mm'],
    ['Carga crítica Euler Fcr', fmt(Fcr, 0), 'N'],
    ['Carga crítica Fcr', fmt(Fcr / 1000, 2), 'kN'],
  ];
  if (lambda) {
    rows.push(['Radio de giro i', fmt(i, 2), 'mm']);
    rows.push(['Esbeltez λ', fmt(lambda, 1), '—']);
    const tip = lambda > 100 ? '⚠ Columna esbelta (Euler válido)' : lambda > 60 ? 'Columna media (verificar)' : '⚠ Columna corta (Euler puede no aplicar)';
    rows.push([tip, '', '']);
  }
  document.getElementById('res-col' + caso).innerHTML = resultCard(rows);
}

// ===================== INIT SHAPE INPUTS =====================
window.onload = function() {
  ['v','b','e','w','c1','c2','c3','i'].forEach(s => {
    const el = document.getElementById('shape-inputs-' + s);
    if (el) el.innerHTML = getShapeInputsHTML('rect');
  });
};
</script>
</body>
